recommended_condition.rationale: Selected based on Rule source (SCDB) as it provides the most complete condition. The substrate is an electron-rich aryl bromide (4-bromoanisole) coupling with ethynylboronic acid. Pd(PPh3)4 is well-established for Suzuki-Miyaura couplings with aryl bromides. 60°C is appropriate for aryl bromides.
